T: Every town needs a dog like this.
D: The true-ish story of a wandering red kelpie who united a mining town in the Pilbara.
P: Serve the mains when the miners at the pub start telling Red Dog stories.
S: the pub in Dampier where the stories get told
Hot chips with chicken salt, salted peanuts and a bowl of pickled onions on the bar, the way an outback pub does it.
the crib room at the mine
Sausage mince with grated onion and carrot rolled in puff pastry, egg washed, baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Tomato sauce.
Pilbara coast, barbie down by the water
Tender squid scored and charred on a hot barbecue with chilli, garlic and lime. Score 600g cleaned squid tubes and cut into pieces.
M: the whole town out for a barbie
Thick beef sausages and rump steaks grilled over coals, onions fried on the hotplate, with potato salad dressed in mayo and chives and a stack of white bread.
the coast up north near the mine
Barramundi fillets pan-fried skin side down in a hot pan until crisp, finished with lemon butter and parsley, with chips and a simple salad.
W: Butter sponge cut into cubes, dipped in raspberry jelly that's just starting to set, rolled in desiccated coconut, chilled until firm. Red and fluffy.
K: the mining town pub on a hot night
Australian lager in stubbies buried in an esky of ice and water, with stubby holders for everyone.

s.note: the crib room at the mine
s.how: Mix 500g pork sausage mince with a grated onion and a grated carrot. Lay along the edge of 2 halved puff pastry sheets, roll up and seal. Brush with beaten egg, cut into pieces and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve hot with tomato sauce.

s.note: Pilbara coast, barbie down by the water
s.how: Score 600g cleaned squid tubes and cut into pieces. Toss with oil, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped chilli and salt. Grill on a very hot barbecue for 1 minute a side and finish with lime juice and coriander.

m.note: the whole town out for a barbie
m.how: Boil 1kg potatoes until tender, cool and dress with mayonnaise and chives. Grill 8 thick beef sausages and 4 rump steaks over hot coals. Fry 2 sliced onions on the hotplate until golden. Serve it all with a stack of white bread and the potato salad.

w.how: Bake a butter sponge in a square tin and cool overnight. Make up raspberry jelly and chill until just starting to set. Cut the sponge into cubes, dip each in the jelly and roll in desiccated coconut. Chill until firm and red and fluffy all over.

d.note: the mining town pub on a hot night
d.how: Fill an esky with ice and cold water, which chills bottles faster than ice alone. Bury the stubbies right down and leave them for 30 minutes. Hand one out to everyone in a stubby holder and keep the lid on between rounds.
